title: bee-capturing: make the promote proposal the first input of a compounding run
action: Add a numbered step to the Compound section stating: when docs/history/<feature>/promote-proposals.md exists it is the first input, reviewed and never applied blindly; every bullet is checked against the bundle (already stated? stated under the wrong owner?) and against the shipped source (does the code still exist?); the area tag comes from the work item's bee.areas and is routinely wrong; what survives is merged, what does not gets a recorded reason; and bee state scribing-run is the receipt that closes the loop either way, including a reviewed-and-declined proposal. Renumber the following steps. Then run the regen chain in this cell: bee dev render-skill-trees, bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, bee dev release-manifest --write.

truths: The step names the file by path so a cold agent can find it
Review-then-merge is stated as the rule, never apply-as-written
The scribing-run stamp is named as the receipt, and a declined proposal still takes it
The regen chain ran in this cell and the manifest check is clean
